label: m3pd-agent-summary
headline: A workstream that exits 0 and files no valid summary now reddens the build, demonstrated in situ the same session; and the five-round R15 series is closed at 16.67 % over 120 draws rather than continued, because the successor frame measures a different quantity -- the wider one, which is the opposite of the direction the brief assumed.

pre_registration: 10 falsifiers and 4 magnitudes, written to scratch before any edit. F1 FIRED IN ITS WEAK FORM, AS PREDICTED: the gate can only be made to fail on a committed control fixture, because no real round carries an exit record and nothing here writes one -- published in those words in gates.toml's blind_to, in docs/GATES.md and in the commit message, rather than called coverage. F10 FIRED as predicted: the truncated fixture reddened run_summary --check until control directories were excluded by name, and broke nothing else. F3 did not fire -- killed-after-filing reads complete, killed-mid-write reads unreadable, never-filed reads absent, on real killed child processes on win32. F8 did not fire: Wilson(20,120) reproduced to (11.06, 24.35) from an independent implementation. F9 did not fire: 600 draws is 25 rounds TOTAL and 20 more, not the brief's '25 more'. F2/F4/F5/F6/F7 did not fire. P1 correct (41 gates, 21 in situ, debt 20, ceiling unmoved). P2 WRONG: predicted 25-45 new tests, got 83. P3 WRONG: predicted the cold stratum is largest by 3x; `recent` is largest at 76 % and cold is 21 %. P4 correct (zero draws carry across the frame change).
how_it_fails: The gate concludes NOTHING about either real round in the register, because nothing writes exits.toml and both are UNATTRIBUTED -- the demonstration is against a fixture and establishes that the code can fail, not that any round anybody ran was checked. The roster_complete = false escape means a launcher that never wants to be accountable never has to be. A vacuous --template summary satisfies the rule. The exit record is a self-report by the launcher that nothing audits. On the sampler: the round stratum is 12 draws, so its own interval after one round is wider than anything the closed series published; the frame is built from claim-shaped NUMBERS, so a claim with no number in it -- most of a workstream's twelve -- is outside it entirely, and that is a population the old series reached and this one does not. Two of docs/CLAIMS-LEDGER.md's four conditions remain unmet and the second grader has still never been run.
not_done: Nothing writes exits.toml. That is a change to whatever spawns the agents, it is still outside this repository, and until it happens the gate's live verdict on every real round is `unattributed`.
No graded round of the successor frame. It stands at n = 0 by construction; this round drew a sample only to exercise the mechanism and graded nothing.
